title: Carl S NDE 6839
content: This is difficult for me to discuss or even write down. I was a fifteen and at a party with other kids. I drank at the party an excessive amount. I passed out from the drinking. At that point, someone at the party was trying to be funny and poured straight Vodka into my mouth, which I drank while I was passed out. After a bit, the people at the party began to worry and I was taken to the hospital. I had stopped breathing a couple of times and they did a blood transplant on me. While I was out, this is what I experienced. I was drunk and having fun. The next thing I know I am in a black void. Completely conscious and more aware than I have ever been. I was not in my body. I was in a void. It was completely black and I had never felt so alone. There was no floor, walls, or light of any kind. It felt like I was falling but without wind or any other senses. I reflected on my life but in a way without any images in my mind. It was self-reflection with a sort of inner dialog with myself. I have never felt so alone or disconnected. I sprung back and woke up with a doctor over me telling me what a lucky kid I was. I went from being completely conscious and alert to being confused and uncoordinated. This experience has left an awful feeling in my life. I remember it very well and it makes me even sad to think about it.

out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: He reported being 'completely conscious and more aware than I have ever been,' 'not in my body,' in a 'black void,' and it 'felt like I was falling but without wind.'

tunnel.movement_other_detail: He described feeling like he was falling, but without wind or other senses.

environment.environment_other_detail: Completely black void with no floor, walls, or light of any kind; he felt extremely alone/disconnected.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Alcohol poisoning/over-intoxication at a party; he passed out after excessive drinking and someone poured vodka into his mouth while he was unconscious; he stopped breathing a couple of times and was taken to the hospital where they did a blood transfusion/transplant.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: He described a black void and intense aloneness, plus self-reflection/inner dialogue; no tunnel, beings, or light were described.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: From being drunk/having fun to suddenly being in a black void (out of body), brief self-reflection, then sudden return/waking with a doctor over him.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Life reflection occurred 'without any images' and as an 'inner dialog' while in a completely black void with no light, floor, or walls.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “The next thing I know I am in a black void. Completely conscious and more aware than I have ever been. I was not in my body.”
